subject.title: Crestodian talk-to-agent command can miss the app handoff

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled onboarding handoff bug stay maintainer-owned, or should a maintainer explicitly opt it into automated repair?
rationale: The fix shape is narrow, but the live issue has the protected `maintainer` label and is assigned to the same area owner, so ClawSweeper should not queue a repair without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep maintainer-owned repair
options.body: A maintainer fixes the host-navigation interception and regression coverage directly or explicitly delegates it later.

options.title: Opt into ClawSweeper repair
options.body: A maintainer removes/overrides the protected routing and asks ClawSweeper to implement the narrow host-command fix.

recommendation.title: Keep maintainer-owned repair
recommendation.body: A maintainer fixes the host-navigation interception and regression coverage directly or explicitly delegates it later.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored and owns the recent Crestodian AI-only and onboarding handoff work and is already assigned on the live issue.
